title: Embeddings and retrieval geometry

claims.claim: Sentence-BERT uses siamese/triplet structures for sentence embeddings
DPR uses question and passage encoders for retrieval
claims.limitations: Do not assert encoder weights always shared

claims.claim: ColBERT scores contextualized token embeddings with late interaction MaxSim
BGE-M3 supports dense, sparse and multivector methods
claims.limitations: SDK support depends on package and model version

claims.claim: Qwen3 Embedding publishes embedding and reranking models
OpenAI text-embedding-3 defaults to small 1536 and large 3072 dimensions
claims.scope: official model guide as checked Nov 2026
claims.limitations: API dimensions parameter and model docs may evolve

toy_demo: All vectors are hand-assigned 2D examples; scores do not represent real model embeddings
